integrationReview.failureMode: AI outage blocks voice transcription, query refinement, agent orchestration, and web search entirely, since search is delegated to ai-microservice.

integrationReview.reason: TASKS.md documents SA-G8-B2 billing/entitlement implementation with Prisma checkout/entitlement models and a runtime-gated payments client, and .env.example declares PAYMENTS_SERVICE_URL/PAYMENTS_API_KEY plus unified PAYMENT_* variables.
integrationReview.contract: Checkout/entitlement flow with callback idempotency, gated by SHOP_ASSISTANT_BILLING_ENABLE_PAYMENT_CREATE
integrationReview.failureMode: When payments-microservice is unavailable or the runtime gate is disabled, live payment creation is blocked; this is the intended safe default until owner-approved checkout smoke passes.
integrationReview.validation: Build/Prisma/diff/no-secret validation passed per TASKS.md; live checkout smoke remains pending owner approval.

integrationReview.reason: shop-assistant searches the open internet for products via ai-microservice-delegated search; it does not integrate with the internal catalog-microservice for its own product data.
No orders-microservice integration is documented; shop-assistant redirects users to external merchant pages rather than creating internal orders.
No warehouse/inventory integration exists in this repository.
No invoicing integration exists in this repository; billing uses payments-microservice's checkout/entitlement model directly.

integrationReview.configuration: Tracked in the canonical repository registry and docs-RAG index

integrationReview.reason: Runtime health and rollout readiness must be observable through the shared monitoring model, consistent with the documented GET /health endpoint and blue/green deployment.
integrationReview.contract: GET /health and Kubernetes readiness checks for rollout control
integrationReview.configuration: Deployment probes and health endpoint in k8s manifests
integrationReview.failureMode: An unhealthy service is prevented from passing rollout readiness and is reported to the owner.
integrationReview.validation: The monitoring stack confirms health, readiness, and service availability.

integrationReview.reason: This service's PostgreSQL database (shop_assistant) holds production session, search, lead, and billing/entitlement data and requires backup coverage consistent with other ecosystem databases.
integrationReview.contract: Scheduled/manual PostgreSQL backups for the shop_assistant database
integrationReview.configuration: backup-db.sh or equivalent invoked against the shop_assistant database
integrationReview.failureMode: Missed backups increase data-loss risk on failure; this must be flagged as an operational blocker if backup automation lapses.
integrationReview.validation: Backup script execution and restore-drill evidence.
